summary: Short kerb on a through road with a no-stopping sign and homes close.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign nearby
Busy through road, no parking lane

drivers.seclusion: Only 27 m long; a roofed structure 4 m and a detached home 12 m from the south kerb, apartments 13 m to the north.
drivers.access_and_room: Verge is a narrow bush strip beside the lane; no pull-off visible.
drivers.traffic: Swann Road bends here with traffic both ways and a junction at the end.
drivers.convention: Council sign says No Stopping Any Time; one car sits at the start but no parking lane.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 12.7 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the south verge; open to the north.
